description: No defined processes for applying secure configurations to system components.
applicability: This signal applies to: Organizations processing, storing, or transmitting cardholder data Payment processors and service providers E-commerce platforms and merchants Point-of-sale (POS) systems Network infrastructure within CDE scope

related_controls: 2.1 Processes and mechanisms for applying secure configurations to all system components are defined and understood.
metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for missing secure configuration standards, lack of hardening procedures for different system types, absence of documented baseline configurations, missing change management processes for security configurations, and no defined responsibilities for maintaining secure configurations across the environment.
